question: How is Diginex positioned against larger ESG software competitors like Workiva or Enablon?

beats.line: Diginex occupies a fundamentally different market position than Workiva or Enablon.
beats.headline: DIFFERENT POSITION
beats.action: A small halftone paper building drops onto a cream chip on open violet ground and settles.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex occupies a fundamentally different market position than Workiva or Enablon.

beats.line: Workiva is a seven billion dollar public company. Diginex is a thirty-four million dollar micro-cap challenger.
beats.headline: $7B VS $34M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the small paper building stays put and a tall paper tower rises beside it; a cream ribbon runs from the building to the tower, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$34M' sits beside the ribbon with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Workiva is a seven billion dollar public company. Diginex is a thirty-four million dollar micro-cap challenger.

beats.line: Its positioning is horizontal platform consolidation, not vertical depth.
beats.headline: HORIZONTAL, NOT DEEP
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the tall paper tower topples sideways and flattens into one wide paper platform slab that fills the frame.
beats.delivery: Its positioning is horizontal platform consolidation, not vertical depth.

beats.line: It is building one platform spanning carbon accounting, supply chain transparency, and customer data.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper platform slab sprouts three stacked paper sheets that lock into place along it; an orange paper arrow runs from the slab to the sheets.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] It is building one platform spanning carbon accounting, supply chain transparency, and customer data.

beats.line: The bet is that enterprises prefer one vendor over point solutions from many.
beats.headline: SINGLE VENDOR
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the three stacked paper sheets press together back into the paper platform slab; a paper hand enters and taps it once, the orange arrow already in place along its edge.
beats.delivery: The bet is that enterprises prefer one vendor over point solutions from many.

beats.line: The thesis only works if cross-sell happens. Buy one module only, and the advantage evaporates.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL OR BUST
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the paper platform slab splits into a paper module stack on magenta ground; all but one module lift away and a torn paper price sheet slides in at the right, a black string running from the stack to the sheet.
beats.delivery: The thesis only works if cross-sell happens. Buy one module only, and the advantage evaporates.

beats.line: Four acquisitions across multiple geographies is complex. Any stumble undermines the thesis.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper module stack tilts over a paper map that unfolds beneath it; the black string to the price sheet holds, and a coin-sized cream tag reading 'Four acquisitions' sits beside the string with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Four acquisitions across multiple geographies is complex. Any stumble undermines the thesis.

beats.line: Larger competitors can bundle ESG modules into broader suites and undercut Diginex on price.
beats.headline: PRICE PRESSURE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper module stack slumps and the torn paper price sheet at the end of the black string swings forward alone, pressing down on it.
beats.delivery: Larger competitors can bundle ESG modules into broader suites and undercut Diginex on price.

beats.line: Diginex has an eighteen to twenty-four month window to prove platform traction.
beats.headline: 18–24 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the torn paper price sheet unrolls into a paper calendar strip across violet ground; the small paper building lands at its near end, a cream ribbon running from the strip to the building.
beats.delivery: Diginex has an eighteen to twenty-four month window to prove platform traction.

beats.line: If integration stalls, it risks becoming a niche player squeezed between larger incumbents.
beats.headline: SQUEEZED OR CREDIBLE
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper calendar strip folds shut and the small paper building fills the frame again, now with a torn strip taped across one corner, the cream ribbon still in place.
beats.delivery: If integration stalls, it risks becoming a niche player squeezed between larger incumbents.
